Epic Games · Fortnite · Hundreds of millions of players
I overhauled the HUD every player sees.
A ground-up refresh of Battle Royale's most-used HUD elements, built on UE5's existing UI architecture with stable, proven engineering.
Epic Games · Fortnite
The storm was always a circle.
So I built a custom rendering pipeline that draws arbitrary storm shapes on the minimap. Now the safe zone can close in as a boomerang, an arrow, or whatever design imagines.
